changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO activity_event (id, type, actor_name, target_title, detail, created_at, space_id, page_id) SELECT nextval('sequence_generator'), CASE WHEN v.source = 'GIT' THEN 'SYNC_IMPORTED' WHEN v.source = 'RESTORE' THEN 'PAGE_RESTORED' WHEN v.version_no = 1 THEN 'PAGE_CREATED' ELSE 'PAGE_UPDATED' END, v.author_name, p.title, 'Version ' || v.version_no || CASE WHEN v.via_agent IS NULL THEN '' ELSE ' via ' || v.via_agent END, v.created_at, p.space_id, p.id FROM page_version v JOIN page p ON p.id = v.page_id WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM activity_event e WHERE e.page_id = p.id AND e.created_at = v.created_at);

changeSet.author: com.yuzhi
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX ix_wiki_activity_space_time ON activity_event (space_id, created_at DESC, id DESC)
